about_short_description.short_description: Truewind is an AI-powered accounting service company that offers bookkeeping and finance services.

product.name: Truewind Digital Accountant
product.description: An AI-powered accounting platform that converts financial source data into review-ready journal entries, reconciliations, schedules, and standard operating procedures for faster close management.

product.name: AI Bookkeeping
product.description: An AI-assisted bookkeeping service for transaction categorization, reconciliation, accrual preparation, and close review, with accountants retaining oversight and approval authority.

product.name: Workpaper Agent
product.description: An AI workpaper automation tool that converts statements, spreadsheets, invoices, and vendor records into reusable workpapers and journal-entry-ready outputs for QuickBooks Online and Sage workflows.

product.name: Sage Intacct Integration
product.description: A native integration that connects Truewind's AI accounting workflows with Sage Intacct for transaction coding, reconciliation, schedule generation, and journal-entry posting.
